mechanism: Benazepril may reduce renal clearance of primaquine metabolites and both drugs can affect hematologic parameters; primaquine carries risk of hemolytic anemia especially in G6PD-deficient patients, potentially worsened by ACE inhibitor use.
action: Monitor hemoglobin, hematocrit, and renal function regularly; ensure G6PD screening before primaquine use; counsel patient on signs of hemolysis; consider dose adjustment of primaquine if renal impairment develops.
